extracted.summary: Found the duplicate-order bug: the checkout button had no debounce, a slow network let a double-click submit twice.
Fixed the duplicate-order bug with a client-side debounce plus a server-side idempotency key on the order-create endpoint.
CI was flaking on the integration test suite about 1 in 20 runs; root cause was a shared test DB not being reset between parallel test workers. Added per-worker DB schemas.
